224:   public static List<LayerStats> computeTileStats(VectorTileProto.Tile proto) {
225:     if (proto == null) {
226:       return List.of();
227:     }
228:     List<LayerStats> result = new ArrayList<>(proto.getLayersCount());
229:     for (var layer : proto.getLayersList()) {
230:       int attrSize = 0;
231:       for (var key : layer.getKeysList().asByteStringList()) {
232:         attrSize += key.size();
233:       }
234:       for (var value : layer.getValuesList()) {
235:         attrSize += value.getSerializedSize();
236:       }
237:       int geomCount = 0;
238:       for (var feature : layer.getFeaturesList()) {
239:         geomCount += VectorTile.countGeometries(feature);
240:       }
241:       result.add(new LayerStats(
242:         layer.getName(),
243:         layer.getSerializedSize(),
244:         layer.getFeaturesCount(),
245:         geomCount,
246:         attrSize,
247:         layer.getKeysCount(),
248:         layer.getValuesCount()
249:       ));
250:     }
251:     result.sort(Comparator.naturalOrder());

256:     Map<String, Integer> encodedLayerSizes = new HashMap<>();
257:     Map<String, Integer> encodedLayerAttributeSizes = new HashMap<>();
258:     try (final var stream = new ByteArrayInputStream(output)) {
259:       while (stream.available() > 0) {
260:         int length = DecodingUtils.decodeVarint(stream);
261:         Pair<Integer, Integer> tag = DecodingUtils.decodeVarintWithLength(stream);
262:         int bodySize = length - tag.getRight();
263:         int attrBytes = 0;
264:         if (tag.getLeft() == 1) {
265:           try (var countStream = new CountingInputStream(stream)) {
266:             final var metadataExtent = MltDecoder.parseEmbeddedMetadata(countStream);
267:             MltTilesetMetadata.FeatureTableSchema metadata = metadataExtent.getLeft();
268:             countStream.skipNBytes(bodySize - countStream.getCount());
269:             for (var column : metadata.getColumnsList()) {
270:               if (!MltTypeMap.Tag0x01.isGeometry(column) && !MltTypeMap.Tag0x01.isID(column)) {
271:                 attrBytes += column.getSerializedSize();
272:               }
273:             }
274:             encodedLayerSizes.put(metadata.getName(), length);
275:             encodedLayerAttributeSizes.put(metadata.getName(), attrBytes);
276:           }
277:         } else {
278:           // Skip the remainder of this one
279:           stream.skipNBytes((long) length - tag.getRight());
280:         }
281:       }
282:     } catch (IOException e) {
283:       throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
284:     }
285:     return input.layers().stream().map(layer -> new LayerStats(
286:       layer.name(),
287:       encodedLayerSizes.getOrDefault(layer.name(), -1),
288:       layer.features().size(),
289:       countGeometries(layer.features()),
290:       encodedLayerAttributeSizes.getOrDefault(layer.name(), -1),
291:       tile.getNumKeys(layer.name()),
292:       tile.getNumValues(layer.name())
293:     )).toList();
294:   }

255:   public static List<LayerStats> computeMltTileStats(VectorTile tile, MapboxVectorTile input, byte[] output) {
256:     Map<String, Integer> encodedLayerSizes = new HashMap<>();
257:     Map<String, Integer> encodedLayerAttributeSizes = new HashMap<>();
258:     try (final var stream = new ByteArrayInputStream(output)) {
259:       while (stream.available() > 0) {
260:         int length = DecodingUtils.decodeVarint(stream);
261:         Pair<Integer, Integer> tag = DecodingUtils.decodeVarintWithLength(stream);
262:         int bodySize = length - tag.getRight();
263:         int attrBytes = 0;
264:         if (tag.getLeft() == 1) {
265:           try (var countStream = new CountingInputStream(stream)) {
266:             final var metadataExtent = MltDecoder.parseEmbeddedMetadata(countStream);
267:             MltTilesetMetadata.FeatureTableSchema metadata = metadataExtent.getLeft();
268:             countStream.skipNBytes(bodySize - countStream.getCount());
269:             for (var column : metadata.getColumnsList()) {
270:               if (!MltTypeMap.Tag0x01.isGeometry(column) && !MltTypeMap.Tag0x01.isID(column)) {
271:                 attrBytes += column.getSerializedSize();
272:               }
273:             }
274:             encodedLayerSizes.put(metadata.getName(), length);
275:             encodedLayerAttributeSizes.put(metadata.getName(), attrBytes);
276:           }
277:         } else {
278:           // Skip the remainder of this one
279:           stream.skipNBytes((long) length - tag.getRight());
280:         }
281:       }
282:     } catch (IOException e) {
283:       throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
284:     }
285:     return input.layers().stream().map(layer -> new LayerStats(
286:       layer.name(),
287:       encodedLayerSizes.getOrDefault(layer.name(), -1),
288:       layer.features().size(),
289:       countGeometries(layer.features()),
290:       encodedLayerAttributeSizes.getOrDefault(layer.name(), -1),
291:       tile.getNumKeys(layer.name()),
292:       tile.getNumValues(layer.name())
293:     )).toList();
294:   }

297:     return features.stream().mapToInt(feature -> countGeometries(feature.geometry())).sum();
